## Assumed (6)

| Key | Value | Source | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activity.transform` | `none` (choices: none, log) | Linear models on daily means with sandwich SEs; log(x + 1) as a variant gives ratios |  |
| `crepitus.count_missing` | `both_required` (choices: both_required, available_knees) | User decision 2026-11-12: crepitus per person is the number of knees with crepitus (0/1/2) | both_required: a person missing either knee's value has no count; available_knees: the count is over the knees measured |
| `crepitus.s2_cut` | `1` (choices: 1, 2) | KOOS S2 'at least rarely' (>= 1) counts a knee, as in analyses/lo2018_crepitus dual and analyses/luyten_early_oa |  |
| `device.purposeful_bout_minutes` | `10` | Spec 5: purposeful walking proxy = minutes in >= 10-minute MV bouts |  |
| `model.corstr` | `exchangeable` (choices: exchangeable, independence) | B3 is knee-level (two knees per person): logistic GEE with an exchangeable working correlation, as in the other crepitus analyses |  |
| `sample.min_step_days` | `4` (choices: 1, 4) | Mirrors device.min_valid_days: a person counts when at least this many of their first valid days have complete steps | Keeps the per-person shares on the same footing as the release's valid-person rule. |
